ai_review.summary: Terrific soundboard master captures a confident, rested 1972 performance.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers praise this recording as an excellent listen, noting the high‑quality soundboard source and the band’s youthful confidence throughout the set. The show is described as strong and well‑rested, representing a peak period in the summer of ’72. No specific song or performance issues are mentioned.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviews are uniformly positive (4‑star) and highlight excellent soundboard quality and a solid performance, but the small sample size limits confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer calls it a 'terrific master of the soundboard' indicating clear, well‑balanced audio.
